headline: Krishnakumar Vaidyanathan resigns from Eris Lifesciences board
hook: Executive Director to exit Eris Lifesciences
summary: Eris Lifesciences has announced the resignation of Executive Director Krishnakumar Vaidyanathan. The departure is scheduled to take effect at the close of business on September 30, 2026. The company notified the stock exchange of this leadership change as part of its regulatory filings.
why_it_matters: Leadership changes at the executive level can influence long-term strategy.
